limitations: Experimental projections; not a validated advantage over market models.
Opportunity and efficiency are estimated separately. Touchdown rates and future-season forecasts require more evidence; smoothing strengths are versioned assumptions awaiting held-out calibration.
Position-specific aging curves are research-informed assumptions, not fitted causal effects.
Draft priors use completed historical cohorts including matched players with zero production; talent is proxied by NFL draft capital.
Status and depth order are daily Sleeper snapshots, not a live injury feed.
Dynasty rankings include current NFL rosters and reserves, excluding retired and unrostered players. Membership is source-timestamped.
QB incumbent protection is a usage-based heuristic, not a confirmed recovery date.
Scoring spread uses current-season statistical appearances only; byes and missing zero-stat games are excluded. Median ± SD is descriptive, not a prediction interval.
Advanced statistics are available only where provided.
Pick curves are provisional research assumptions.
